how.h2: Up and running in three steps
how.intro: No technical skills or expensive hardware needed. You prepare your content in the dashboard, and the Android box in your venue sends it to every TV within seconds.
flow.aria: Flow: you make a change in the dashboard, the ScreenPano server sends it to the box, and the box shows the same picture on every TV via an HDMI splitter
step1.alt: Colour and logo settings in the dashboard: preset themes and your own colours
step1.p: Sign up with your business name and a password. Upload your logo, then pick one of six preset themes or enter your brand colours.
step2.alt: TV pairing screen: username and password form next to a QR code and a 6-digit code
step2.p: Install the app on an Android TV box or a Windows PC. Scan the QR code on screen with your phone, or type the 6-digit code into the dashboard. Your password is never stored on the device.
step3.alt: Dashboard overview: live preview, setup steps and quick actions
step3.p: Add videos, photos, prices and announcements. Your changes reach the screen within seconds, and you can watch them in the live preview.
scr.h2: You decide how your screen looks
scr.intro: Pick a ready-made layout, then drag and resize the blocks. Every venue gets its own screen: matches take centre stage in a sports bar, the price list in a bakery.

faq.intro: Can't find your answer here? Get in touch, and we'll also help you with setup.
faq.items: Any Android TV box or smart TV running Android 5 or later. If your venue already has a Windows PC connected to a TV, you can use the Windows app instead of a box. The app opens on a sign-in screen and starts automatically whenever the device is switched on.
How does playing from a PC work?

Install the Windows app and connect the TV to your computer via HDMI. If the TV is detected as a second display, the content opens there in full screen and you can keep using your computer. The app keeps the display awake, starts with Windows and installs new versions overnight.
I have several TVs. Do I need a box for each one?
No. Connect a single box to an HDMI splitter and every TV shows the same picture. With the Pro plan, the second box can serve as a spare or drive a separate area.
What happens if the internet goes down?
The box keeps playing the videos, photos and settings it has already downloaded, even after a restart. Live data such as scores and exchange rates updates once the connection is back.
Can I manage everything from my phone?
Yes. The dashboard works on any phone, so you don't need a computer to upload a video, change a price or switch a promotion on and off. You can also create separate logins for your staff.
Videos such as MP4 and MOV, and photos in JPG and PNG. Uploaded videos are automatically optimised to play smoothly on TV and go on screen as soon as they're ready.
Can I control when content appears?
Yes. You can set days, time slots and date ranges for every item and every price-list category. For example, your breakfast menu can appear only on weekend mornings.
What happens when the trial ends?
Playback pauses and the TV shows a notice, but your content is not deleted. As soon as your plan starts, the screen comes back on by itself.

Passwords are stored as one-way hashes, all connections are encrypted and data is backed up every night. You can download all your data and delete your account from the dashboard. Details are in our Privacy Notice (in Turkish).
